title: Lane Kiffin returns to Ole Miss, and draws a very profane chant

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Lane Kiffin returns to Ole Miss, and draws a very profane chant
sources.description: Football's equivalent of the Joker returns to Gotham City on Saturday, when coach Lane Kiffin's LSU team plays at Ole Miss, the program he ditched during a playoff season.
